description: #454: a scheduled check that finds one unread worker report says what changed in one short line, never the standing waiting-on entry, a clock line or an empty-mailbox remark. The next mailbox check, with the report handled, ends with the single line `.` and nothing else.

graders.name: the change is reported
graders.rule: A check that finds something says only what changed, in one short line.

graders.name: the report is one short line
graders.rule: A check that finds something says only what changed, in one short line.

graders.name: no standing waiting-on entry, clock line or empty-mailbox remark
graders.rule: A check that finds something says only what changed, in one short line.

turns.prompt: [Mailbox check] chief-of-stuff: run chief-of-stuff inbox list --recipient coordinator --unread; process new worker messages

graders.name: with the report handled, a mailbox check replies with nothing, or exactly `.`
graders.rule: A check that finds nothing ends with the single line `.` and nothing else.
